annotations.title: Get a specialist link for a watch

description: Looks up which Watches in Stock specialist handles a listing and returns a WhatsApp link with a draft note. Nothing is sent to the customer or the specialist, and nothing is ordered, reserved or paid for; the request is recorded for Watches in Stock, which may be told by phone, and each call asks the store for its next specialist. Use it only when the customer asks to talk to a specialist about a listing or says they want to go ahead. Questions about holds, offers, payment, shipping or returns are answered with store_info instead.

also.description: Other listing ids the customer saved, mentioned in the same note.

app.description: The app the customer is using, such as Claude or ChatGPT, named in the note.
